description: This Java source file defines an enumeration for measurement windows used in monitoring metrics. It specifies different window durations and resolutions, such as one minute, one hour, and one day, with corresponding methods to retrieve these configurations.

classes.name: MeasurementWindow
classes.description: An enumeration representing predefined measurement windows with specific durations and resolutions used for tracking and monitoring purposes.

methods.name: forName
methods.description: Retrieves a MeasurementWindow enum instance matching the given name label, returning an Optional that contains the enum if found.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the measurement window and its resolution in ISO-8601 format.

methods.name: getWindow
methods.description: Returns the Duration object representing the measurement window length.

methods.name: getResolution
methods.description: Returns the Duration object representing the resolution of the measurement window.
